{{Quote|Attention, Victor Echo One Two come in. Repeat, Victor Echo One Two.|An announcement|<ref name="BF2" />}}
'''Victor Echo One Two''' was an individual who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point during the war, an announcement from control aboard a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] called for Victor Echo One Two.<ref name="BF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Victor Echo One Two was mentioned in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''. The dialogue that mentions Victor Echo One Two can be randomly heard in the Venator's hangar during gameplay.<ref name="BF2" />
